question: How many monthly active developers used the LangGraph library in September 2026?

brief.research_question: As of today (2026-10-04), how many monthly active developers (i.e., developers who used/actively worked with the LangGraph library) were using LangGraph in September 2026, using any public, citable figure that exists? Provide the figure (or clearly state that it cannot be determined from public sources) along with full citations to the underlying public data.
